question: What is the value of \(9901\cdot101-99\cdot10101?\)
solution:
Splitting the factors into convenient sums reveals large terms that cancel. By the distributive property,
\[
\begin{aligned}
9901\cdot101&=(9900+1)(100+1)\\
&=990000+9900+100+1,\\
99\cdot10101&=99(10000+100+1)\\
&=990000+9900+99.
\end{aligned}
\]
Subtracting cancels the matching \(990000\) and \(9900\) terms, leaving
\[
100+1-99=\boxed{2}.
\]
The answer is choice \(\boxed{\text{A}}\).
